title: Deterministic Pre-LLM Context Optimization

claims.assertion: Pre-LLM deterministic 3-tier context pruning prevents context blowouts in multi-turn reasoning loops.
AST code skeletonization combined with tabular and whitespace compaction achieves 35-60% token reduction without latency overhead.
Co-located AgentContextOptimizer integrated into StepExecutionEngine without kernel mutation.

distilled_learning:
### Distilled Heuristic
Multi-turn agent execution loops must apply deterministic 3-pass context optimization (whitespace deduplication, tabular/JSON truncation, AST code skeletonization) prior to model invocation to bound token budgets and eliminate context overflow.
